sports.body: The Pakistan Cricket Board has announced a commentary panel of six for the upcoming men's ODI tri-series. Notably, renowned commentators Michael Atherton and Nasser Hussain will be missing after a controversial interview on Imran Khan's prison health caused a stir. The matches between Pakistan, England, and Sri Lanka will take place from October 18 to October 31, with coverage from former international players at venues in Rawalpindi and Lahore.
